target_customer: Businesses in fintech, legal, SaaS and CRM that run phone based tasks across languages
problem: Phone work such as collections, follow ups and support is costly and language limited. Struct offered multi-lingual AI voice agents that handle calls, claiming tens of thousands of calls a day.
business_model: Usage based AI voice agent platform, pricing not found

founders.name: Eamonn Gahan
founders.background_notes: YC page says he worked at various UK startups and Intercom as an individual contributor and engineering manager.

exit.reason: Not public. YC lists the company as Inactive and one archive notes no shutdown announcement was made.

competitors.name: Vocode
competitors.what: Open source library and API for building voice agents on top of LLMs, including phone calls
competitors.funding_then: YC W23, same batch; later funding figures conflict

technical_complexity.rationale: Real time speech to text, LLM and text to speech over telephony with multilingual handling needed latency engineering, but components were available as APIs in early 2023.

defensibility.rationale: Voice agent stacks were assembled from the same third party models, and many startups and open source projects were building the same thing.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Many voice agent startups funded in 2024 and 2025 crowded the space. No acquisition of Struct was found.

market_need_then: Phone automation demand was clear and LLM voice quality was improving in 2023. No Struct customer evidence beyond its own claim of tens of thousands of daily calls was found.

branding.domain_note: Used struct.app, which now redirects to a domain sale page.

brand_strength.rationale: The name is a programming term shared with other companies such as a crypto data company at struct.to, and no brand press for this company was found.

outcome_analysis: Struct entered W23 as a multi-lingual AI voice agent platform with a three person team and later became inactive. Only the standard YC money is reported, the domain now redirects to a sale page, and no shutdown note or cause was found. The voice agent field became crowded with funded rivals, but no source ties Struct's end to that, so no failure factor is assigned.
notes: struct.app redirected (302) to fortune.domains, a domain for sale page, which I did not fetch, so the site is treated as dead. The $500K figure rests on VCBacked; another low reliability page describes it as the standard YC deal of 125 thousand dollars for 7 percent plus a 375 thousand dollar uncapped note. Vocode is listed as a same batch rival, not an earlier one; its YC launch post is undated in the snippet.
